title: Retirement Planning
shortText: Estimate the corpus you may need and build it steadily.
whatItIs: Retirement planning starts with estimating how much you may need to maintain your lifestyle after you stop working, adjusting for inflation and life expectancy. A disciplined SIP in a mix of equity and debt schemes, reviewed periodically and shifted gradually towards lower risk as retirement approaches, is a common approach.
whoItSuits: Working professionals and self-employed individuals at any age - starting early gives your investments more time to grow.
howItWorks: Use the retirement calculator to estimate a target corpus
Discuss an asset mix suited to your age and risk profile
Start SIPs and link them to a Retirement goal on your dashboard
Review progress every year and step up SIPs as income grows

faqs.question: How much corpus do I need?
faqs.answer: It depends on your expenses, inflation, expected returns and life expectancy. Our calculator gives an illustrative estimate.

faqs.question: Should I stop equity investments near retirement?
faqs.answer: Many investors gradually reduce equity exposure as retirement approaches; the right mix depends on your situation.
